tei:div.tei:p: "!#: khro bcu srung ma dang bcas pa'i dbang chog mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bzhugs so: 1$0000250gnam lcags 'khor lo/1$0000300

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ dbang gi bdag nyid he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: rdo rje phur pa'i dbang rgyas pa dbang 'bum du yongs su rdzogs shing 'dus la: gang zag spros pa la dga' ba'am: rgyas par sgrub dbang du bskur na: khro bcu za bsod dang bcas pa'i dbang ni: dbang tsaka rgyab yig bcas te: gtso bo'i dbang rdzogs: phrin las kyi dbang bskur mtshams su bskur bar bya'o: hūm̐: steng gi phyogs nas 'beb mdzad pa: khro chen rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang: yum chen shes rab sgra 'byin ma: steng phyogs lha yi gdon tshogs zlog: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: dbang bskur yongs rdzogs thob par shog: oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ kā ra a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs nas gzir mdzad pa: khro chen rnam par rgyal ba dang: yum chen dbyings kyi snyems ma ste: shar phyogs dri za'i gdon zlog cing: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: dbang bskur yongs rdzogs thob par shog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta bi dza ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: hūm̐: shar lho mtshams nas 'joms mdzad pa'i: khro chen dbyug pa sngon po dang: yum chen rdo rje sder mo ni: shar lho me lha'i gdon tshogs zlog: dpal ldan drag po'i dkyil 'khor nas: dbang bskur yongs rdzogs thob par shog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta nī la daṇ+ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: hūm̐: lho yi phyogs nas gsod mdzad pa: khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po dang: yum chen dur khrod bdag mo ni: lho phyogs gshin rje'i gdon tshogs zlog: rab 'jigs rngam pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: dregs pa tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ya mān+ta ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: lho nub mtshams nas sgrol mdzad pa: khro chen mi g.yo mgon po dang: rab 'jigs rdo rje gtun khung ma: lho nub srin po'i gdon zlog cig: dpa' brjid drag po'i dkyil 'khor nas: dregs pa tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ār+ya a tsa la a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: nub kyi phyogs nas 'ching mdzad pa'i:

khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal: yum chen rdo rje gtum mo ni: nub phyogs klu yi gdon tshogs zlog: dbang chen rngam pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rab 'jigs drag rtsal dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+rī wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: hūm̐: nub byang mtshams nas 'gug mdzad pa'i: khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang: yum chen dbang gi snyems ma ni: nub byang rlung lha'i gdon tshogs zlog: snang srid 'gugs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: khams gsum dbang sdud dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta a pa ra dzi ta hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐: byang gi phyogs nas gnon mdzad pa: khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang: yum chen rdo rje rlung 'byin ma: byang phyogs gnod sbyin gdon rnams zlog: rtog med chos dbyings dkyil 'khor nas: dngos grub yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: byang shar mtshams nas stobs mdzad pa: khro chen khams gsum rnam par rgyal: yum chen rdo rje gsod byed ma: byang shar bgegs kyi gdon rnams zlog: gdug pa tshar gcod dkyil 'khor nas: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: hūm̐: 'og gi phyogs nas sdom mdzad pa: khro bo'i rgyal po stobs po che: yum chen rdo rje skyod byed ma: 'og phyogs klu gdon zlog byed pa: rab 'jigs khros pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: mthu dang nus pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā ba la hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas za gsod khra thabs kyi dbang bskur te: dbang tsaka rgyab yig tu byas te: slob ma'i gnas gsum dang lag tu gtad cing: hūm̐: za byed khro bo phag gi mgo: rdo rje thog chen 'beb mdzad cing: rtog tshogs rang grol chos dbyings sbyor: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las kyis: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya mā ra se na pra mar dha na ye a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ:

hūm̐: za byed khro bo stag gi mgo: shar gyi phyogs nas gzir mdzad cing: 'jigs brgyad zhi bar mdzad pa ste: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las kyis: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya mā ra se na pra mar dha na ye a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: za byed khro bo g.yag gi mgo: shar lho'i phyogs nas 'joms mdzad pa: thogs med rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las kyis: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya mā ra se na pra mar dha na ye a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: za byed khro bo sha ba'i mgo: lho yi phyogs nas gsod mdzad pa: 'byor drug rgyas pa'i las mdzad cing: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las kyis: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya mā ra se na pra mar dha na ye a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: za byed khro bo gzig gi mgo: lho nub mtshams nas sgrol mdzad cing: skad cig rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las kyis: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya mā ra se na pra mar dha na ye a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: za byed khro bo byi la'i mgo: nub kyi phyogs nas 'ching mdzad pa: rdzu 'phrul stong gsum khyab par rgyug: khams gsum dbang du sdud par byed: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las kyis: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya mā ra se na pra mar dha na ye a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: za byed khro bo spyang ki'i mgo: nub byang mtshams nas 'gugs mdzad cing: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las la brtson: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las kyis: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya mā ra se na pra mar dha na ye a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: za byed khro bo seng ge'i mgo: byang gi phyogs nas gnon mdzad cing:

dgra srog stobs kyis sgrol zhing gnon: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las kyis: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya mā ra se na pra mar dha na ye a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: za byed khro bo dom gyi mgo: byang shar mtshams nas stob mdzad cing: dgra dang bgegs kyi gnyen po che: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las kyis: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya mā ra se na pra mar dha na ye a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: za byed khro bo dred kyi mgo: 'og gi phyogs nas spor mdzad cing: dug gsum khams gsum bsgral nas ni: mi ldog chos kyi dbyings su spor: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las kyis: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma ra se na pra mar dha na ye a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: zhes za byed khro bo bcu'i dbang 'di khyad par phrin las drag po'i dbang yin pas: shin tu gces pa yin no: da ni gsod byed khro mo bcu yi dbang bskur te: dbang rten ni dbang tsaka gi rgyab yig tu byas te: gong ltar gnas gsum dang lag tu gtad de: hūm̐: gsod byed bud med 'jigs pa'i gzugs: khro mo mi bzad rmigs bu'i mgo: tshangs pa lha gdon zlog mdzad cing: mngon spyod las mdzad chen mo yis: dbang bskur phrin las 'grub par shog: ma rag mo yag mo a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐: gsod byed bud med 'jigs pa'i gzugs: khro mo mi bzad bya rgod mgo: dri za'i gdon tshogs zlog mdzad cing: gsod byed las mdzad chen mo yis: dbang bskur phrin las 'grub par shog: ma rag mo yag mo a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐: gsod byed bud med 'jigs pa'i gzugs: khro mo mi bzad bya rog mgo: me lha'i gdon tshogs zlog mdzad cing: srog gcod las mkhan chen mo yis: dbang bskur phrin las 'grub par shog: ma rag mo yag mo a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐: gsod byed bud med=

khro mo mi bzad 'ug pa'i mgo: gshin rje'i gdon tshogs zlog mdzad cing: khams gsum 'jigs byed chen mo yis: dbang bskur phrin las 'grub par shog: ma rag mo yag mo a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐: gsod byed bud med 'jigs= khro mo mi bzad khwa ta'i mgo: srin po'i gdon tshogs 'dul mdzad cing: dregs pa 'joms mdzad chen mo yis: dbang bskur phrin las 'grub par shog: ma rag mo yag mo a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐: gsod byed bud med= khro mo mi bzad pu shud mgo: chu lha'i gdon tshogs zlog mdzad cing: srid gsum g.yo byed chen mo yis: dbang bskur phrin las 'grub par shog: ma rag mo yag mo a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐: gsod byed bud med= khro mo mi bzad khra yi mgo: rlung lha'i gdon tshogs zlog mdzad cing: khams gsum 'khrugs byed chen mo yis: dbang bskur phrin las 'grub par shog: ma rag mo yag mo a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐: gsod byed bud med= khro mo mi bzad pha wang mgo: bgegs kyi gdon tshogs zlog mdzad cing: srid gsum khram 'debs chen mo yis: dbang bskur phrin las 'grub par shog: ma rag mo yag mo a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐: gsod byed bud med= khro mo mi bzad sre mong mgo: bgegs kyi gdon tshogs zlog mdzad cing: dgra bo'i srog la rngams mdzad mas: dbang bskur phrin las 'grub par shog: ma rag mo yag mo a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐: gsod byed bud med 'jigs pa'i gzugs: khro mo mi bzad byi ba'i mgo: sa bdag gdon tshogs zlog mdzad cing: dgra bo'i bdun rgyud rtsad gcod mas: dbang bskur phrin las 'grub par shog: ma rag mo yag mo a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: zhes bskur te: za gsod khra thabs kyi dbang ni: sprul pa las byed kyi dbang yin te: phrin las drag po'i sgrub pa la gces pa yin no: s+ya mya y+ya: kha tham: spyi don gsum gyi tha ma: dam can rnams bran du bkol ba dang: pho nya gnad la dbab pa'i dbang ni bsdus pa dbang 'bum du shes la:

re zhig brgyud 'dzin snying gi bu la rgyas par bskur na: phur srung bcu gnyis kyi phur pa sbam ste dar gyis bcings la slar yang dgug gzhug bya/ zhun chen: 'o ma: rak+ta'i mtsho bsham: phur pa la bzhi snying dril ba'i sngags nyungs dkar nag la bzlas shing gtor te: gzi brjid bskyed: mnga' gsol: gu gul gyis bdug: sha chen bsreg: rdo rje slob dpon badz+ra ku mā ra'i nga rgyal gsal bar bsgom zhing: slob ma rnams gsang bdag tu gsal bas: hūm̐: bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs: sngon chad ji ltar khas blangs pa'i: dam tshig de las ma 'da' bar: bdag ni gzhung bzhin sgrub byed na: dam can ma g.yel dam la 'dus: mngon spyod phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces sbam phur rnams thun gyis brab: rdo rje slob dpon gyis phyag tu bsgril zhing: slob bu'i snying kha: lte ba: lag mthil du gtad de: hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen he ru ka: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: shwa na mched bzhi'i dus la bab: bdag nyid mched bzhi'i dus la bab: sa bdag mched bzhi'i dus la bab: las kyis bkal ba'i dgra bo rnams: lnga phung rdul du brlag pa'i phyir: bstan pa 'dzin pa'i slob bu la: bran dang bka' nyan pho nyar gtad: 'di la 'go zhing bsrung ba dang: bcol ba'i phrin las grub pa dang: bstan pa srung ba'i las mdzod cig: ka taṃ ka ye dza ye bi dza ye a dzi te a pa ra dzi te ma ra se na pra mar ta na ye dam las ma 'da' sa ma ya: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes gtad la: slob mas phur pa g.yas g.yon du phyar zhing 'dril: rked la lan gsum bskor zhing 'debs tshul bya zhing bskor ro: des ni dpa' bo las la sprad pa dang: khyi bzang bdag po la sprad pa 'dra ste: phrin las thogs med du 'grub par 'gyur ro: de nas dge bsnyen nyer gcig dang ging bzhi'i phur pa sbam te gtad la: hūm̐: rdo rje phur pa'i srung ma ru: khas blangs dam bcas bka' nyan tshogs: dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig dang:

bse lcags dung dang tā ki 'jigs: pho nya las byed srog la rngams: ral gri zang yag klad la bskor: phur pa dgra bo'i snying la 'debs: bran dang bka' nyan pho nyar gtad: brnag pa'i las la mthu ma chung: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las mdzod cig: shī tram ka ra ya ma ra se na pra mar ta na ye sa ma ye a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: ces phur pa 'dril zhing phyogs bcur gzir: rkang 'og la bskor nas zhabs su gtad do: des ni rgyal po'i bka' bran g.yog gis nyan pa dang 'dra'o: de nas sgo phur bzhi blangs la: hūm̐: pu shud skya ka srin bya khra mgo ma: rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi nas: 'dzin 'ching sdom rdeg dgra bo 'ching bar mdzad: tshad med phyag rgya bzhi yis dbang bskur bas: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa dang: mngon spyod drag po'i dbang chen thob par shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: ma ra se na pra mar ta na ye a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes phur pa phyogs bzhir 'dril zhing: dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhir 'debs tshul bya'o: des ni rgyal pos dpa' bo ngar btags te mnga' gsol ba dang 'dra'o: de nas phur pa'i srung ma dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi las dbang bskur te: mu khyud chen po nas rtsang phur nyi shu rtsa brgyad phyungs te: dar mthing nag gis sbam ste: 'bru gzhong gi dbus su bzhag la: gong gi phur srung ltar: gu gul bdug: sha chen bsreg: zhing lpags phyar: rkang gi gza' bus rak+ta phyogs bcur gtor: bshugs pas 'bod: nyungs thun 'thor zhing mnga' gsol: slar yang dbang mor 'gug bstim bskul byang ltar: bskul btang la: rdo rje slob dpon ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas: slob bu gsang bdag tu gsal ba la: pho nya las byed bran g.yog gi tshul du gtad de: sbam phur: snying kha: lte ba: gsang gnas/ brla g.yas g.yon dang zhabs su gtad cing: bh+yo: dpal gyi bka' nyan las byed tshogs: ma tshogs dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyis: tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir:

mtshan tsam 'dzin par byed pa yang: g.yo sgyu med cing gus ldan pa'i: sems kyis blangs te spyi bo yi: gtsug tu blangs te bskur bar bya: de skad khyod kyis bro bor te: dam bca' bsnyel du mi rung ngo: skal ldan 'di yi lus grib bzhin: rtag tu mi 'bral srung ma mdzod: brnag pa'i las la rbad pa'i tshe: gang la dmigs pa shor ra re: mthu rtsal yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dzaḥdzaḥdza: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: nyer brgyad bzlas la: dzaḥbh+yo: sngon chad ji ltar khas blangs pa'i: mngon spyod phrin las grub par mdzad: srung mar bkod do 'bangs su gtad: las mkhan pho nya'i tshul du gtad: bka' dang dam la gnas par mdzod: ho: skal ldan khyod la dbang phyug nyer brgyad las byed pho nya'i bka' 'di gtad pas: 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i mnga' dbang dang ldan par gyur cig: des ni rgyal po'i bka' bzhin phrin las thogs med du 'grub cing: phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad khyi bzang bzhin du bsrung bar 'gyur ro:

de nas tshogs la rol: mnga' gsol: gser skyems gtong: rjes kyi dbang dang: kha skong ni dbang 'bum ltar mtha' skyong ngo: khro bcu khra thabs nyi shu: phur srung: dbang phyug bka' gtad dang bcas pa: dbang rgyas pa la mos sam: brgyud 'dzin gyi bu la gtad do: pho nya las kyi dbang rim mkhar chen bzas ldang lung khra mo brag tu bris pa'o: spo to bar ma'i brag la rgya yis btab: dge bsnyen ldang lhas bka' yi bya ra gyis: ྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ lho brag gter ston rat+na gling pa'i thugs thig go /shog ser yang bu bshus te dag par yod/ shog ser bai ro'i phyag bris/ dha na ko sha'i yi ge las bshus so// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ sku gsum mtsho rgyal/ sprul sku rat+na gling pa/ sras tshe dbang grags pa/ ā yu kīrti/ so ba mgon po rdo rje/ des bdag rat+ne shwa ra la'o/// /
